purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical clinic patient registration subsystem (患者登録 P02) within the JMA ORCA standard receipt (レセプト) software
purpose.summary: ORCGP02 is the main program for the patient registration screen group (P02) in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles screen navigation, patient master data entry/update, insurance combination management, hospitalization records, and CLAIM file processing. It is driven by an MCP event loop (LINK/PUTG/CLICKED/OTHER) and delegates to numerous subprograms via CALL and COPY-included record layouts.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (69 copybooks) for record layouts and subprogram interfaces
MCP/SPA linkage area pattern (JMA ORCA framework)
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS / MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen dispatch
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded, garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP DB access layer
GOTO used for early exit within sections
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple screen area copybooks (P02.INC, P02A.INC, P02D-F.INC, P98.INC, etc.)
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese); decoded as latin-1 causing garbled comment text. Source is truncated to first 16000 chars out of 151824 bytes (3641 lines). The JMA ORCA system is a well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt software; this is a production-grade component. No COMP-3 usage detected despite medical/financial domain — likely uses display numerics throughout.
